default.description: Mockingbird default capability set. Grants every Tauri-declared window the core permission bundle (event:listen/emit, window:show/hide/close, webview:*, app:*, etc.). Without this file present, capabilities.json is empty and listen() / window.hide() / emit_to() callbacks silently no-op while invoke() of #[tauri::command] handlers still works — the exact failure mode of mb-z5y wave-1 + wave-2 (ADR 0034, 0035). Phase 10 hotfix-of-hotfix (mb-a0f3 / mb-q2if): the `command_center` window was added in Wave 1A but never added here, so its `listen('command_center:state', ...)` silently no-op'd, leaving the React app stuck on whatever snapshot getCommandCenterState() returned at mount time — typically Closed → renders null → empty black box. SAME ROOT CAUSE as mb-z5y. THIRD time this has bitten; whenever you add a new Tauri-declared window in tauri.conf.json, also add it here.
